function.description: Appoint the MANAGER (validates work orders). Omit dwarf_id to pick a citizen without a position.
function.name: appoint_manager

function.description: Place a workshop or furnace centred on a W site (or x,y,z). Types and their footprints and inputs: query workshop_types.
function.name: build_workshop

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Place a farm plot on soil floor: an F or G site, or a dug R room.
function.name: build_farm

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Queue a work order from a frozen recipe. For any other DF manager order (a job type, a reaction, item-type conditions) use add_manager_order. Recipes: brew_drink: Still, brewable plant + empty barrel -> 5 drinks; brew_drink_from_fruit: Still, brewable fruit + empty barrel -> 5 drinks; cook_meal: Kitchen, 2+ cookable ingredients -> prepared meals; make_barrel: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 barrel; make_bed: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 bed; make_bin: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 bin; make_chair: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 chair; make_charcoal: WoodFurnace, 1 log -> charcoal; make_door: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 door; make_hatch_cover: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 hatch cover; make_table: Carpenters, 1 log -> 1 table
function.name: add_order

when.description: with repeat: only while all hold, e.g. [{"stock": "drink", "below": 50}]

items.description: give exactly one of below / at_least

function.description: Queue any DF manager order: job is a df.job_type name (query manager_order_types), with reaction for job CustomReaction. For the frozen recipes (brew_drink, make_bed, ...) use add_order.
function.name: add_manager_order

when.description: with repeat: only while all hold, e.g. [{"item_type": "DRINK", "below": 50}]

items.description: give exactly one of below / at_least

flags.description: DF item condition flags (query manager_order_types: condition_flags), e.g. unrotten, empty

item_type.description: a DF item type (df.item_type), e.g. DRINK, PLANT, BARREL; ANY = any item type (then flags are required)

function.description: Remove a work order by id.
function.name: cancel_order

function.description: Enable a DFHack plugin. autochop: fells trees; autofarm: sets each farm plot's crop every season from the seeds in stock; seedwatch: keeps seeds of each crop from being cooked or brewed below a threshold; autolabor: assigns labors; autoclothing: queues clothing orders
function.name: enable_automation

function.description: Create the fortress's one squad from dwarf_ids (adult citizens without a position or squad) or size N (the N with the highest combat skills, then strength). Members keep working until it has an order.
function.name: create_squad

function.description: Give the squad a uniform template: a melee weapon plus that armour, from items that exist.
function.name: equip_squad

function.description: Order the squad: attack (all visible hostiles, or target_ids), station at x,y,z, or stand_down.
function.name: squad_order

function.description: Add an A site or a dug R room, `levels` levels down from it, to the Shelter burrow (the civilian-alert burrow).
function.name: create_burrow

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Turn the civilian alert on or off (civilians stay in the Shelter burrow while on).
function.name: civilian_alert

function.description: Place a hatch cover over a down stair (E site) or a door in a doorway (D site); uses a free hatch cover / door item.
function.name: build_door

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Build a wall on a floor tile (D site) from a log or boulder.
function.name: build_wall

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Lock or unlock a door/hatch by door_id, or all of them if omitted.
function.name: lock_door

function.description: Designate an R site for digging (default 3x3; w,h to change).
function.name: dig_room

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Designate a staircase down from an S site to z_bottom (default one level down).
function.name: dig_stairs

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Place free furniture items, one per free floor tile, in an A site or a dug R room (count, default 1).
function.name: place_furniture

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Make an activity zone on an A site or a dug R room.
function.name: make_zone

site.description: a site id from the observation's sites (e.g. W2)

function.description: Assign an office or bedroom zone to a citizen (the zone's Assign button).
function.name: assign_zone

function.description: Mark a tame animal of the fortress for slaughter (the animal list's Slaughter button). A dwarf with the butchery labor slaughters it at a Butchers workshop.
function.name: slaughter

function.description: Let 1-28 in-game days pass. Stops early at a tripwire; the result says which.
function.name: advance_days

stop_on.description: tripwires that stop the advance (default: all)
